words.origin: 古法语 coart（缩着尾巴的那个）← coe / cue（尾巴）← 拉丁语 cauda，加贬义后缀 -ard；与拉丁语 ars（技艺）无关，同含 -ar- 只是拼写偶合
words.native_definition: a person who lacks the courage to face danger or pain
words.core_concept: one who backs away when danger comes – 危险一来就往后缩的那个人
words.core_image: 狗见了人夹起尾巴往后退，主人一抬手它先钻到桌子底下
examples: He was called a coward for running away.
Only a coward would hit a child.
semantic_expansions: 胆小鬼：遇事就退、不敢往前的那一个
懦夫：该站出来时始终不肯站出来的人
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 古法语 cortine ← 晚期拉丁语 cortina（帷幕）；与拉丁语 tenere（握住）、tangere（触）都不同源，拼作 -tain 纯属偶合，更早词源不明
words.native_definition: a piece of hanging cloth that covers a window or a stage
words.core_concept: hanging cloth that shuts off what is behind – 挂起来把后面遮断的那块布
words.core_image: 一块布沿轨道拉过去，窗外的光一下被挡住，屋里暗下来
examples: She drew the curtains before turning on the light.
The curtain rose and the play began.
semantic_expansions: 窗帘：挡在窗户上的那块布，拉上就看不见外头
幕布：戏台前面那块大布，升起来戏才开始
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.root_logic: com-（完全）+ pli（plere 填满）+ -ment（物）→ 把礼数填够的那句话
words.origin: 意大利语 complimento ← 西班牙语 cumplimiento（礼数尽到）← 拉丁语 complere（填满）；与 complement 同出一源，后来分写两形
words.native_definition: a remark that expresses praise or admiration
words.core_concept: words that fill out what courtesy asks for – 把礼数填满的那句话
words.core_image: 有人夸你今天这身衣服好看，你听着不好意思又高兴
examples: She paid him a compliment on his cooking.
He complimented her on the fine speech.
semantic_expansions: 赞美：把好话说到位，听的人受用
夸奖：当面说对方哪里做得好
致意：见面时把该有的客套话补上

words.root_logic: con-（一同）+ junct（jungere 套到一处）+ -ion（事）→ 把两边套在同一副轭里的那一处
words.origin: 拉丁语 coniunctio ← coniungere：com-（一同）+ iungere（套到一处），过去分词 iunctus
words.native_definition: a word that links two clauses, or the state of things happening together
words.core_concept: the piece that yokes two parts into one – 把两部分套进同一副轭的那一处
words.core_image: 两个句子中间放一个小词，前后就接成一句话
examples: And is the commonest conjunction in English.
The two events happened in conjunction.
semantic_expansions: 连词：夹在两句之间把它们接起来的那个词
结合：两样东西合到一处的状态
同时发生：两件事凑在同一时候一起来

words.root_logic: con-（一同）+ tam（tangere 触）+ -inate（使…）→ 挨上了就跟着变脏
words.origin: 拉丁语 contaminare（弄脏）← contamen（接触、染上）← con-（一同）+ tangere 的词干 tag-（触）
words.native_definition: to make something dirty or harmful by adding a bad substance
words.core_concept: spoiling a thing by letting a bad one touch it – 让脏东西挨上，整样就跟着坏
words.core_image: 一滴墨掉进整桶清水，水色立刻发灰，整桶都不能喝了
examples: The leak contaminated the town water supply.
Do not let raw meat contaminate the salad.
semantic_expansions: 污染：坏东西掺进来，整批都不能用
弄脏：挨上一点就沾了，擦不干净
带坏：人挨着人，坏习气也跟着传过去

words.root_logic: con-（一同）+ vey（via 路）→ 一路陪着送过去
words.origin: 古法语 conveier（护送上路）← 通俗拉丁语 conviare：com-（一同）+ via（路）
words.native_definition: to carry something from one place to another, or to make an idea known
words.core_concept: taking a thing along the road to the other end – 顺着路把东西带到那一头
words.core_image: 传送带把箱子一路送到另一头，也能把一个眼神递到对面
examples: Pipes convey water to the whole village.
Her face conveyed more than her words.
semantic_expansions: 运送：把货物顺路带到目的地
传达：把话或消息一路递到人手里
表达：把心里的意思送到对方那边去

words.root_logic: de-（去掉）+ cis（caedere 切）+ -ive（有…性质的）→ 一刀切下去，再不回头
words.origin: 法语 décisif ← 中世纪拉丁语 decisivus ← 拉丁语 decidere：de-（去掉）+ caedere（切）
words.native_definition: settling a question, or able to make choices quickly and firmly
words.core_concept: cutting the matter off so it cannot drag on – 一刀切断，事情不再拖
words.core_image: 会开到一半有人拍下桌子定了方案，散会后没人再提别的
examples: That goal was decisive in the final.
A good leader must be decisive.
semantic_expansions: 决定性的：这一下切下去，结局就定了
果断的：该切就切，不在两头之间来回

words.root_logic: de-（离开）+ sir（sidus 星）+ -able（可…的）→ 值得抬头去望的那一个
words.origin: 古法语 desirable ← 拉丁语 desiderabilis ← desiderare（渴望）← de- + sidus（星）
words.native_definition: worth having or wanting because of its qualities
words.core_concept: worth reaching up toward – 值得伸手去要的那一样
words.core_image: 招聘栏里那个岗位人人都投，工资和地点都挑不出毛病
examples: A quiet flat is highly desirable here.
Fluent Japanese is desirable for this post.
semantic_expansions: 令人向往的：一看见就想要，人人都盯着
可取的：条件上站得住，值得选它

words.root_logic: de-（彻底）+ stin（sta 立定）+ -y（名词）→ 早就立定在那里、挪不动的那一条
words.origin: 古法语 destinee ← 拉丁语 destinata ← destinare（立定、钉住）← de- + stare（站立）的使动一支
words.native_definition: the events that will happen to someone, seen as already fixed
words.core_concept: what has been stood firm in advance – 事先立定、不再移动的那一条
words.core_image: 一条路上早钉好了木桩，走到哪一步都绕不开那几个桩子
examples: She believed it was her destiny to teach.
No one can escape his own destiny.
semantic_expansions: 命运：一生里绕不开的那条线
天命：被认作上头早已定下、由不得自己的安排

words.root_logic: e-（从中）+ leg（legere 挑选）+ -ant（…的）→ 一样样挑出来的，才这么讲究
words.origin: 拉丁语 elegantem ← eligere（挑选出来）：ex-（从中）+ legere（拣选）
words.native_definition: pleasingly graceful and simple in style or appearance
words.core_concept: made of picked-out choices, nothing left in by accident – 每一处都是挑过的，没有多余
words.core_image: 一身素色衣服剪裁贴身，只戴一只细表，进屋人人回头看
examples: She wore an elegant black dress.
He found an elegant solution to the problem.
semantic_expansions: 优雅的：举止和穿着都挑过，看着舒服
雅致的：器物花样不多而处处得当
简洁的：办法或证明里没有一步是多的

words.root_logic: e-（从中）+ lig（legere 挑选）+ -ible（可…的）→ 可以被从人堆里挑出来的
words.origin: 晚期拉丁语 eligibilis（可选出的）← 拉丁语 eligere：ex-（从中）+ legere（拣选）
words.native_definition: having the right qualities or conditions to be chosen or allowed
words.core_concept: fit to be picked out of the group – 条件够得上，能被挑出来
words.core_image: 报名表交上去，工作人员照条件核对一遍，在名字后打了勾
examples: Only members are eligible for the discount.
She is eligible to apply this year.
semantic_expansions: 符合条件的：门槛上的每一条都对得上
有资格的：够格进这个名单，可以来领或来考

words.root_logic: e-（向外）+ mot（mov 动）+ -ion（事）→ 心里被搅动起来的那一下
words.origin: 法语 émotion ← 拉丁语 emotio ← emovere：ex-（向外）+ movere（动）
words.native_definition: a strong feeling such as joy, anger, or fear
words.core_concept: something inside stirred out of its rest – 心里原本静着的东西被搅动起来
words.core_image: 听到那句话，胸口猛地一紧，手抖得握不住杯子
examples: He spoke with real emotion about his father.
She tried to hide her emotions.
semantic_expansions: 情绪：心里一时被搅起的那个状态
情感：长久存着、遇事就动的那一份
激动：动得厉害，身上也跟着显出来

words.origin: 拉丁语 corporatio ← corporare（结成一个整体）← corpus（属格 corporis：身体）；本项目未为 corpus 一族建根
words.native_definition: a large business or group that the law treats as a single body
words.core_concept: many people counted as one body before the law – 一群人在法律上算作一个身体
words.core_image: 几千人分散在各地上班，对外只用一个名字签合同
examples: He works for a large oil corporation.
The corporation was fined for the spill.
semantic_expansions: 公司：合起来做买卖的那个整体
法人团体：法律上当成一个人来对待的那一群
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 古法语 cople ← 拉丁语 copula（把两样系在一起的带子）← co-（一同）+ apere（系住）；本项目未为 copula 一族建根
words.native_definition: two people or things taken together, or to join two things
words.core_concept: two things tied so they go as one – 两样被系住，从此一同走
words.core_image: 两只手扣在一起，也可以是两节车厢挂上同一个钩
examples: A young couple moved in next door.
They coupled the two carriages together.
semantic_expansions: 一对：数目上凑成两个的那一组
夫妻：结成一家的那两个人
连接：把两样挂上同一个扣
words.decomposable_note: 经法语入英语的借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 古法语 cort ← 拉丁语 cohortem（围起来的院子）：co-（一同）+ hort-（围场，与 hortus 花园同支）；本项目未为 cohors 一族建根
words.native_definition: a place where legal cases are heard, or an enclosed area for a ball game
words.core_concept: an enclosed yard where a fixed business is settled – 围起来的一块地，事情在里面按规矩了断
words.core_image: 四面围起来的一块空地，中间画着线，边上坐着一排人看着
examples: The case will go to court next month.
They booked a tennis court for Sunday.
semantic_expansions: 法庭：围起来的那间屋子，是非在里面判定
球场：围起来画好线的那块地，按规矩打球
宫廷：君主住的那个大院，臣子在里面听差
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 拉丁语 curvus（弯的），名词一支经拉丁语 curva（弯线）入英语；本项目未为 curvus 一族建根
words.native_definition: a line or surface that bends smoothly without any sharp angle
words.core_concept: a line that bends without breaking – 一条不带折角地弯过去的线
words.core_image: 公路顺着山脚一路弯过去，没有一个直角
examples: The road curves sharply to the left.
She drew a smooth curve on the paper.
semantic_expansions: 曲线：图纸上圆顺地弯着的那条线
弯道：路上转过去的那一段
弯曲：让直的东西弯过来这个动作
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 拉丁语 demonstrare（指明给人看）：de-（彻底）+ monstrare（指示）← monstrum（示警之物）← monere（提醒）；本项目未为 monere 一族建根
words.native_definition: to show clearly how something works or that something is true
words.core_concept: putting a thing where all can see it plainly – 摆到众人眼前，一步步指给人看
words.core_image: 店员把机器搬到台前，当众按一遍键，让围观的人看清每一步
examples: He demonstrated the machine to the buyers.
The results demonstrate that the method works.
semantic_expansions: 演示：当面做一遍给人看清楚
证明：把根据摊开，让人不得不信
示威：一群人走到街上，把主张摆给众人看
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 拉丁语 dilutus ← diluere：dis-（分开）+ luere（洗、冲）；luere 与 lavare（洗）同支，本项目未为这一族建根
words.native_definition: to make a liquid thinner or weaker by adding water
words.core_concept: washing a thing out until it is thin – 兑水冲开，浓的变淡
words.core_image: 一勺蜂蜜倒进整壶水里搅开，尝一口几乎没味道了
examples: Dilute the paint with a little water.
Too many members diluted her influence.
semantic_expansions: 稀释：加水进去，浓度降下来
冲淡：颜色或味道被水带走一部分
减弱：不限液体，力量或影响也能被摊薄
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 法语 embarrasser（阻住、使为难）← 西班牙语 embarazar ← barra（横杠）；barra 更早词源不明
words.native_definition: to make someone feel awkward and self-conscious
words.core_concept: a bar thrown across so one cannot go on – 前面横上一杠，人卡在那里
words.core_image: 当着一屋子人说错了对方名字，脸一下发烫，话接不下去
examples: His question embarrassed the whole table.
She was embarrassed by the loud praise.
semantic_expansions: 使窘迫：让人当场卡住，不知怎么接
使难为情：戳到不好意思的地方，脸上挂不住
words.decomposable_note: 经法语入英语的借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.root_logic: co-（一同）+ ordin（ordinare 排成序）+ -ate（使…）→ 两把尺排进同一套次序，交出一个位次
words.origin: 拉丁语 co-（一同）+ ordinare（排列成序）← ordo（行列、次序）
words.native_definition: a set of numbers that fix the position of a point on a map or graph
words.core_concept: numbers set in one shared order to fix a point – 放进同一套行列里，用来定住一个点
words.core_image: 地图上横竖两把尺交出一格，报出两个数就找得到那一点
examples: He gave us the coordinates of the camp.
Enter the coordinates into the ship's computer.
semantic_expansions: 坐标：两条互相垂直的尺各报一个数，点的位置就定下来了

words.origin: 古法语 contree ← 通俗拉丁语 contrata（terra）（迎面铺开的那片地）← 拉丁语 contra（对面、正对着）；是拉丁借词而非日耳曼词，本项目未为 contra 一族建根
words.native_definition: a nation with its own government, or land away from towns
words.core_concept: the stretch of land lying out in front of you – 摊在面前的那一整片地
words.core_image: 站在坡上往前看，一整片田野铺到天边，远处立着一道界碑
examples: She has visited over thirty countries.
They moved to the country last spring.
semantic_expansions: 国家：一片地连着住在上面的人和管事的政府
乡下：城外那一片田野和村子
地区：一整片连着的地面，按地势或用途分开说
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 中古英语 court（← 古法语 cort ← 拉丁语 cohortem 围起来的院子）+ yard（← 古英语 geard 围场）；前半是拉丁借词，后半是日耳曼词，两个同义成分叠在一起
words.native_definition: an open space enclosed by the walls of a building
words.core_concept: open ground fenced in on every side – 四面拦住、中间露天的一块地
words.core_image: 四面墙围出一块露天空地，中间一口井，晾着几件衣服
examples: Children were playing in the courtyard.
The hotel has a quiet inner courtyard.
semantic_expansions: 庭院：房子围出来的那块空地，自家人在里面走动
天井：屋子中间留出的一小方露天，光从上头下来
words.decomposable_note: 早期借词，经古英语或中古英语阶段传入，词形已归化，无可拆的词缀

words.origin: 中古英语 cupborde：cup（← 古英语 cuppe ← 晚期拉丁语 cuppa 杯）+ board（← 古英语 bord 板）；本义是摆杯盘的那层板，前半是经古英语传入的拉丁借词
words.native_definition: a piece of furniture with doors and shelves for storing things
words.core_concept: shelf boards shut behind a door – 关在门后的那几层板
words.core_image: 厨房墙上一排带门的格子，拉开门里面摞着盘子和罐头
examples: The plates are in the kitchen cupboard.
She hid the box in a cupboard.
semantic_expansions: 橱柜：带门带层板，用来收放东西的家具
壁橱：嵌在墙里的那一种，不占地方
words.decomposable_note: 早期借词，经古英语或中古英语阶段传入，词形已归化，无可拆的词缀

words.origin: 古英语 curs（诅咒的话），更早词源不明；与拉丁语 cursus（跑）同形而无关
words.native_definition: a word or wish calling harm down on someone, or to swear at someone
words.core_concept: harsh words sent out to bring harm down – 放出一句话，要祸事落到那人头上
words.core_image: 有人朝着背影狠狠说了一句狠话，旁边的人听了直摇头
examples: He cursed loudly and slammed the door.
She believed the old house was under a curse.
semantic_expansions: 诅咒：说出话来盼对方遭祸
咒骂：气头上骂出难听的话
祸根：像被那句话缠上一样，长久跟着的坏运
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 希腊语 diagignoskein（分辨清楚）：dia-（透过、分开）+ gignoskein（认知），经晚期拉丁语 diagnosis 入英语；是希腊借词而非日耳曼词。库中 gnoscere 根收的是拉丁一支，与本词同出印欧语「知」一根而分支不同，照 regula 与 rect 的先例不合并
words.native_definition: to find out what illness or fault someone or something has
words.core_concept: telling one thing apart from another until the cause is named – 一样样分开辨，直到认出是哪一种
words.core_image: 医生把片子举到灯前看了半分钟，在单子上圈出一处
examples: Doctors diagnosed a rare blood disorder.
The engineer diagnosed the fault in minutes.
semantic_expansions: 诊断：看过症状和片子，认定是哪一种病
判定病因：不限人身上，机器毛病出在哪也这么找
words.decomposable_note: 希腊借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 中古英语 doun（← 古英语 of dūne 从高处下来）+ stairs（← 古英语 stǣger 台阶）；两半都是日耳曼词，本是短语后写成一词
words.native_definition: on or to a lower floor of a building
words.core_concept: down the steps to the floor below – 顺台阶下到底下那一层
words.core_image: 脚步声顺着台阶一级级往下，最后停在门厅的地板上
examples: She ran downstairs to answer the door.
The downstairs windows were all shut.
semantic_expansions: 楼下：底下那一层，就在台阶下头
往楼下：动作朝下面那一层去
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 中古英语 erthequake：earth（← 古英语 eorþe 土地）+ quake（← 古英语 cwacian 抖动）；两半都是日耳曼词
words.native_definition: a sudden violent shaking of the ground
words.core_concept: the ground itself shaking underfoot – 脚底下那片地自己抖起来
words.core_image: 吊灯突然乱晃，杯子从桌沿滑下去，墙上裂开一条缝
examples: The earthquake destroyed hundreds of homes.
A strong earthquake struck the coast at dawn.
semantic_expansions: 地震：地面自己抖动，上面的东西跟着乱
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆

words.origin: 晚期拉丁语 edibilis ← 拉丁语 edere（吃）——与库中 edere-publish 那个同形的 edere（ex＋dare 交出）无关，勿混；是拉丁借词而非日耳曼词，本项目未为「吃」这一支建根
words.native_definition: fit or safe to be eaten
words.core_concept: safe to put in the mouth – 放进嘴里没问题的那一样
words.core_image: 野地里两朵相似的菌子，本地人拿起一朵咬了一口，另一朵扔开
examples: Not every wild berry is edible.
The flowers are edible and slightly sweet.
semantic_expansions: 可食用的：性质上没毒，人能拿来当食物
能吃的：眼前这一份没坏、下得了口
words.decomposable_note: 拉丁借词，本项目未为其词族建根，按整体记

words.origin: 古英语 elles（另外地）+ hwær（何处）；两半都是日耳曼词，中古英语时合成一词
words.native_definition: in, at, or to some other place
words.core_concept: at some other place than this one – 不在这儿，在另外的地方
words.core_image: 这家店门口贴着告示，要买的那样东西得往下一条街去问
examples: The book is not here; look elsewhere.
Many workers went elsewhere for better pay.
semantic_expansions: 在别处：人或物不在眼下这个地方
到别处：动作朝另一个地方去
words.decomposable_note: 日耳曼核心词，本身即词根，无拉丁词缀可拆
